added.summary: animation-timeline takes scroll(), view() and named timelines from scroll-timeline and view-timeline (with -name, -axis and view-timeline-inset longhands), seen across a subtree with timeline-scope; animation-range (-start, -end) takes normal, length-percentages and the named ranges cover, contain, entry, exit, entry-crossing and exit-crossing. A scroll-driven animation's time is its timeline's progress, so it moves with the scroller and costs nothing while the scroller rests. The animation shorthand now resets animation-timeline and animation-range, as in CSS.
